name: Jamie Porter
source:
??? Major, Year 3

Most of Wryn Mayer know him as the "campus boyfriend," but you'll get to know him as Jamie. His good looks and flawless manners make him an unapproachable icon; no one knows much about him, and he seems to prefer it that way. However, those who learn his boundaries might have a shot at learning about the person between the lines...
